selection: Arithmetic mean of validation endpoint-action RMSE divided by the same validation metric of the initialization checkpoint, one model for all available domains
primary: Unordered two-action terminal XYZ difference RMSE over movable nodes. Relative to the lower of the fixed CoPhyNet and PETS baselines scored on the same data.
train: Replay of Stage 27's train and validation seeds, groups, commands and coarse observations. A measured pushing edit is one contact pair shared across all four candidates.
shift: Fresh 256 five-block towers, 320 P2/P8 CausalWorld layouts and 320 Push-T layouts at damping .25.
